triples.tail_surface: rated torque, fatigue, and avoidance of overheating
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 额定扭矩、疲劳及避免过热
triples.evidence_text: Couplings are to be designed for the rated torque, fatigue, and avoidance of overheating.

triples.tail_surface: environmental and service conditions over the design life of the coupling
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 联轴器设计寿命内的环境和服务条件
triples.evidence_text: Where elastomeric material is used as a torque-transmitting component, it is to withstand environmental and service conditions over the design life of the coupling, taking into consideration the full range of maximum to minimum vibratory torque.

triples.tail_surface: total loss of propulsion capability of the vessel
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 船舶推进能力完全丧失
triples.evidence_text: Flexible couplings with elastomer or spring type flexible members, whose failure will lead to total loss of propulsion capability of the vessel

triples.head_surface: Flexible couplings with elastomer or spring type flexible members
triples.head_canonical_zh: 带弹性体或弹簧型柔性元件的柔性联轴器
triples.tail_surface: provided with a torsional displacement limiter
triples.evidence_text: Flexible couplings with elastomer or spring type flexible members, whose failure will lead to total loss of propulsion capability of the vessel, such as that used in the line shaft of a single propeller vessel, are to be provided with a torsional displacement limiter.
The device is to lock the coupling or prevent excessive torsional displacement when a pre-determined torsional displacement limit is exceeded.

Conditions where the allowable vibratory torque or the allowable dissipated power may be exceeded under the normal operating range of the engine are to be identified and are to be marked as a barred range in order to avoid continuous operation within this range.

triples.head_surface: Flexible couplings for generator sets or motors

triples.tail_surface: short time impact torque due to electrical short-circuit conditions up to 6 (six) times the nominal torque
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 电气短路条件下高达6倍额定扭矩的短时冲击扭矩
triples.evidence_text: Flexible couplings for generator sets or motors are to be capable of absorbing short time impact torque due to electrical short-circuit conditions up to 6 (six) times the nominal torque

triples.tail_surface: transmit the maximum power at rated speed

triples.evidence_text: They are to be designed to transmit the maximum power at rated speed.
